column9: Northamptonshire County Council, abolished 31 March 2021. Retained against the issuing code and deliberately NOT propagated to the successors. In 2018 Northamptonshire was two-tier: the county held social care and education while housing and homelessness sat with the seven district councils, so the issuing authority did not hold the functions S12 exists to signal about. Propagating would also fan out - one predecessor, two successors, so any join by predecessor doubles the notice. successor_codes is reference only and must never be used as a join path.
